## Files / quality checks

- [ ] I included a **new, dated** evidence/JURISDICTION/OBSERVATION_DATE/ extract for every new verified point.
- [ ] Each extract contains short exact official wording, source URL/title, date metadata and limitations.
- [ ] I have not modified, overwritten, renamed or deleted historical evidence.
- [ ] Data rows follow every column of the exact current CSV schema; no extra columns/commas.
- [ ] Calculated processing-date fields are consistent with metric_date (source_updated_date fallback only).
- [ ] I have not compared non-equivalent average, backlog, minimum-wait or service-standard metrics.
- [ ] I ran python3 scripts/validate_contributions.py (paste result below).
- [ ] I checked that no applicant-specific or private personal information is included.
- [ ] I have distinguished official fact, calculation and inference.
- [ ] I have not inferred wrongdoing or deliberate delay from observed patterns.
